name: Chimichurri
siboNotes: Traditional chimichurri contains garlic, making it high FODMAP and unsuitable for SIBO diets. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms due to fructan content.
preparationTips: Make FODMAP-friendly version using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Use extra parsley and oregano to maintain flavor complexity
Add a pinch of asafoetida powder for umami depth
Store homemade low-FODMAP version in refrigerator for up to 1 week
alternatives: Garlic-infused oil with parsley and oregano
Simple herb oil with chives and parsley
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin K from parsley
Provides healthy fats from olive oil
